NAME: CLIC verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-CLIC-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Aggregate 32 interrupt sources into a single winning ID and level ...
details: Aggregate 32 interrupt sources into a single winning ID and level for the core.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_clic_single
details: Oracle: each source individually reaches the core with the right ID Coverage goal: all 20 assigned IDs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, selection checks ([N-7.8] valid with level 0, [N-7.5] ID 10 wins, random selection vs reference model 300 trials) - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression; per-source reach of the IDs is by chip program sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c steps 1, 2 and 4 (RESULT: PASSED). No dedicated block-level sweep of all 20 IDs.

NAME: R-2 Per-ID enable pending and 8-bit level.
details: Per-ID enable, pending, and 8-bit level.
implementation_note: Source: CLIC

NAME: t_clic_regs
details: Oracle: enable, pending, level read/write behaviour Coverage goal: all 32 CLICINTCFG
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, checks CLICINFO, CLICIE/CLICINTCFG reset values, IE bits hardwired 0, CLICIP mirrors the source lines, CLICIP ignores writes, PSLVERR on unmapped offset and beyond CLICINTCFG[31] - 8 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Level read/write of all 32 CLICINTCFG is not swept.

NAME: R-3 All sources shall be level-triggered fixed in hardware.
details: All sources shall be level-triggered, fixed in hardware.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0009

NAME: t_clic_level_trig
details: Oracle: source held → handler re-enters after mret
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, sw/tests/t_clic.S, sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c, sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c (t_chip_irq holds the watchdog warning line but does not check re-entry after mret).

NAME: t_clic_no_edge
details: Oracle: a pulse shorter than the take latency may be missed; a held source never is
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, sw/tests/t_clic.S, sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c, sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c.

NAME: R-4 All interrupts disabled at reset.
details: All interrupts disabled at reset.
implementation_note: Source: Safety

NAME: t_clic_reset
details: Oracle: all disabled after reset; no spurious take
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, checks tagged R-4: CLICIE resets to 0 and CLICINTCFG resets to 0 - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. The no-spurious-take half is not checked.

NAME: R-5 ID 0 shall never be assigned to any source.
details: ID 0 shall never be assigned to any source.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0009

NAME: t_clic_id0
details: Oracle: CLICIE[0] unwritable; ID 0 never wins
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, check [N-6.2]/[N-6.3] IE bits 0, 7, 23-31 hardwired 0, and 'nothing pending -> valid low, ID reads 0 [N-7.13]' - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-6 The machine timer shall not consume a CLIC ID.
details: The machine timer shall not consume a CLIC ID.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0010

NAME: t_clic_no_mtip
details: Oracle: timer interrupt arrives via mip.MTIP, no CLIC ID involved
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c steps 2 and 3 (no CLIC source reports the timer cause 0x8000_0007; the timer takes no CLIC ID) and sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c (machine timer trap 0x8000_0007); chip-level, not in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, RESULT: PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 Selection shall complete in one cycle and add no latency to the ...
details: Selection shall complete in one cycle and add no latency to the core's take decision.
implementation_note: Source: Timing

NAME: t_clic_latency
details: Oracle: valid in the same cycle as enable & pending
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, sw/tests/t_clic.S, sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c (valid is checked in the same #1 as the stimulus, but no check is named or tagged for latency).

NAME: R-8 An ID s level shall be changeable while that ID is pending ...
details: An ID's level shall be changeable while that ID is pending, without losing the pending state.
implementation_note: Source: Firmware

NAME: t_clic_level_change
details: Oracle: level write while pending, pending preserved
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, check tagged R-8 'level changed while pending; pending kept' - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_clic_tiebreak
details: Oracle: equal level → lowest ID Coverage goal: all adjacent ID pairs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, check [N-7.5] 'equal level, lowest ID wins' plus the random reference-model check - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Adjacent-pair coverage goal is not swept.

NAME: t_clic_nest
details: Oracle: higher level preempts; equal does not Coverage goal: 8 level pairs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, sw/tests/t_clic.S, sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c, sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c (t_clic.S tests mintthresh and MIE, not nesting).

NAME: t_clic_thresh
details: Oracle: mintthresh blocks levels at or below it Coverage goal: boundary values
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: sw/tests/t_clic.S sections 2 to 4 (mintthresh writable, 0xFF blocks every interrupt, 0 admits them) with the +IRQ_SWEEP testbench - sim/sanity/t_clic.log TOHOST=1 PASSED in the 2026-10-04 regression; the log has no [PASS] lines, so the check count is not available. Only the boundary values 0 and 0xFF are used.

NAME: t_clic_spurious
details: Oracle: source deasserts before the take; handler tolerates
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, sw/tests/t_clic.S, sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c, sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c.

NAME: t_clic_wfi_wake
details: Oracle: pending enabled interrupt wakes WFI with MIE clear
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no check for this test found in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, sw/tests/t_clic.S, sw/chip/t_chip_irq.c, sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c (t_clic.S section 5 tests MIE=0 blocks the take but contains no WFI; t_chip_irq wakes from WFI with MIE set).

NAME: t_clic_random
details: Oracle: constrained-random source assertion vs. a reference model Coverage goal: all 20 IDs, nesting depth ≥3
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/clic/tb_clic.sv, check 'random selection vs reference model: 0/300 mismatches' - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. Nesting depth of 3 is not covered.

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_id0_never_enabled
details: ID 0 is never a winner and never enableable (R-5, N-7.12)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv ([N-6.2]/[N-6.3] IE bits 0 hardwired 0).

NAME: a_id0_never_wins
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv (random selection vs reference model; IE[0] hardwired 0).

NAME: a_reserved_ids
details: reserved IDs can never be enabled (N-6.3)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv ([N-6.2]/[N-6.3] IE bits 7, 23-31 hardwired 0).

NAME: a_valid_correct
details: valid is exactly the OR of enable & pending
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv ([N-7.8] valid with level 0; random selection vs reference model).

NAME: a_winner_legit
details: the winner really is enabled and pending
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv (random selection vs reference model; disabling ID 10 hands selection to ID 1).

NAME: a_winner_max_level
details: the winner has the maximum level among enabled pending IDs
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv ([N-7.5] highest level wins).

NAME: a_tiebreak_lowest_id
details: tie-break is lowest ID (N-7.5)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv ([N-7.5] equal level, lowest ID wins).

NAME: a_pending_comb
details: pending is purely combinational from the source (N-7.1)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv ([N-6.4] CLICIP mirrors the source lines).

NAME: a_clicip_ro
details: no pending set/clear path exists: CLICIP is unaffected by writes
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv (CLICIP ignores writes).

NAME: a_level_change_safe
details: level change while pending does not disturb pending (R-8)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv (R-8 level changed while pending; pending kept).

NAME: a_reset_disabled
details: everything disabled at reset (R-4)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in tb/clic/tb_clic.sv (R-4 CLICIE resets to 0).

NAME: a_no_mtip_id
details: no CLIC ID is ever asserted for the machine timer (R-6, N-7.14)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. Checked procedurally in sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c (steps 2 and 3).

NAME: a_no_latency
details: selection adds no register stage (R-7)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED - named in the specification only.

NAME: Added in the 2026-10-04 run
details: Checks added and defects found when the flow was run in order on 2026-10-04. Defects and check counts for this block are in the rows below.

NAME: INT-2 ID 7 reserved
details: CLIC ID 7 reported the machine timer's cause, so the DMA error interrupts moved from IDs 7..12 to 8..13 and ID 7 is reserved.
implementation_note: Covered by sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c step 2 (every DMA error interrupt reaches its CLIC ID, no CLIC source reports 0x8000_0007), RESULT: PASSED. Status: FIXED, owner to confirm. Not checked in tb_clic.sv.

NAME: INT-3 enable mask from ID map
details: The SPI slave's interrupt could not be enabled because the default IE_MASK still excluded IDs 13 and 14; the mask is now generated from the ID map.
implementation_note: Found by sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c step 4 (each peripheral line reaches its ID), RESULT: PASSED. Status: FIXED. tb_clic.sv checks the hardwired-zero IE bits only against the default mask.

NAME: Bench checks added
details: Check count: 15 on 2026-10-04 before the merge, 17 after it. Two more checks come from the APB protocol checker (tb/common/apb_checker.v) bound on this bench's config port on 2026-10-03.
implementation_note: tb_clic.sv: 17 checks, all PASS (sim/tb_clic/run.log).
